explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` and a single `next_token()` walk to collect only ordinary `#text` tokens plus opener text from `TITLE` and `TEXTAREA`, which the docs say are special text-bearing elements; `SCRIPT` and `STYLE` are naturally excluded because their contents are not ordinary `#text` descendants. I then truncated the decoded UTF-8 result by code points with `mb_strlen()` and `mb_substr()` when available, with a Unicode regex fallback.
